review.rationale: The Recommendation strictly adheres to the bounded offline lineage reconciliation contract. It selects Option A, explicitly refuses server reads, repairs, rollbacks, redeployments, and release authority, and preserves all missing-evidence boundaries (deployment authorization, switch source, intent, safety, and production readiness remain UNKNOWN or false). Evidence bindings are sufficient and traceable via SHA-256 hashes to classification results, governance artifacts, and PR #27 metadata. Commit ancestry interpretation is sound and limited to Git object relationships without inferring deployment or commercial truth. Release role separation is maintained, PR #27 boundary is respected, caps and stop conditions are comprehensive, and non-authorizations are complete. The Result contract is sufficient for a future Decision gate. No blockers or corrections are identified.
